title: a0kit: the de Sitter-Unruh modified-inertia acceleration-scale toolkit
description: A dependency-light (numpy-only) Python library implementing the calculational relations of the de Sitter-Unruh MODIFIED-INERTIA framework for the MOND acceleration scale a0. It computes: the horizon-derived scale a0 = c H_Lambda / Z = c^2 sqrt(Lambda/32pi) ~ 9.36e-11 m/s^2 (both the pure-dark-energy 'canonical' and total-density 'alt' footings); the inversions Lambda = 32 pi a0^2 / c^4 and rho_DE = 4 a0^2/(G c^2); the interpolation kernel nu(y) = sqrt(1+1/y) (the functional form of Milgrom 1999, Phys. Lett. A 253, 273); the a0-line identity g_obs^2 - g_bar^2 = a0 g_bar and its single-point inverse; the redshift law a0(z)/a0(0) = sqrt(rho_DE(z)/rho_DE,0) under a CPL dark-energy history; and the deep-MOND baryonic Tully-Fisher flat velocity V = (a0 G M_bar)^(1/4). Includes a self-test and a minimal test suite (all passing). SCOPE (stated in code and README): the library COMPUTES the framework's relations; it does not derive or prove them. The value of a0, the coefficient Z = sqrt(32pi/3), and the sign of the inertial correction are POSITED, not derived; the interpolation kernel is Milgrom's 1999 functional form -- the framework's distinctive content is the cH_Lambda/Z coefficient and a modified-inertia completion. Both a0 footings are carried because which cosmic density sets the scale is not settled by the framework. Used to produce and verify the numerical results of the framework's papers (e.g. the a0-line/Lambda-inversion measurement, 10.5281/zenodo.21419735). Development home: https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula (a0kit/). License AGPL-3.0.
notes: Version 1.0.1 (fixes from a 3-agent adversarial audit: strict footing validation -- a footing typo now raises ValueError instead of silently returning the ~21% different alt value; the Planck-alone vs Planck+BAO input-chain fork between the two canonical entry points documented in docstring+README; domains documented incl. the signed a0_line convention; -O-proof test suite with coverage for the canonical branch, rho_de_from_a0, and the ValueError; honest README import instructions). Prior: 1.0.0 archived for citability and for the ASCL registration of the code. The archive contains a0kit.py (the library), test_a0kit.py (test suite, all passing), README.md, and codemeta.json. Verified before deposit: self-test EXIT 0 from a cold download; all URLs and reference DOIs resolve. Milgrom 1983 (ApJ 270, 365) and 1999 (PLA 253, 273) credited for the kernel; the a0~sqrt(rho_DE) numerical coincidence predates the framework (Limbach, Psaltis & Ozel 2008).
